desc: Prove that sorting each array in descending order makes the three-dimensional value grid monotone along every axis.
Design the max-heap state as `(negative_value, i, j, k)` and compute values with Python integers to safely handle products up to roughly \(10^{18}\).
Implement neighbor expansion for `(i+1,j,k)`, `(i,j+1,k)`, and `(i,j,k+1)`, checking bounds and avoiding duplicate states with a set.
Verify the implementation on the supplied samples and edge cases including \(N=1\), duplicate values, and \(K=N^3\) when small.
Analyze complexity as \(O(N\log N + K\log K)\) time and \(O(K)\) additional memory.
